summary.en: A mass spectrometer identifies molecules by ionising a sample, separating the resulting ions by their mass-to-charge ratio, and recording the abundance of each ratio, producing a mass spectrum whose fragmentation pattern acts as a structural fingerprint of the original molecule in addition to giving its precise molecular mass.
summary.et: Massispektromeeter identifitseerib molekule, ioniseerides proovi, eraldades tekkinud ioonid nende massi-laengu suhte järgi ja registreerides iga suhte esinemissageduse, tekitades massispektri, mille fragmenteerumismuster toimib algse molekuli struktuurse sõrmejäljena lisaks tema täpse molekulmassi andmisele.
